slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
dangerously confident

a signature scent

pick one scent and wear it every day. it sounds small, but having a signature is a quiet way of telling yourself you're someone worth remembering, every single day.

walking with purpose

walk everywhere this week like you're two minutes late for something you're excited about. purposeful steps change how you breathe, and how people read you from across the room.

the clean shoes rule

keep your shoes clean, always. people notice the details you think nobody sees, and taking care of small things is how you start taking yourself seriously.

evening lessons

before bed, spend 5 minutes learning one thing: a famous artist, a scientific discovery, a moment in history. falling asleep a little smarter every night adds up faster than you think.

slides.texte_overlay:
a morning ritual

build a 10 minute morning ritual you never skip: stretch, water, one page, cold splash. starting the day on your own terms makes it much harder for anyone else to set the tone.
